prompt:
Goal: Create a bright Japanese summer portrait magazine cover featuring a young East Asian woman with long dark wavy hair, soft natural makeup, delicate earrings, and a calm slightly curious expression standing outdoors in strong but gentle sunlight.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 editorial cover, cinematic high-resolution photography, shallow depth of field, airy Japanese lifestyle aesthetic, sunlit green and blue color palette.

Main subject: The woman is placed slightly right of center, shown from about the waist up. She wears a white open-knit sleeveless camisole, light blue high-waisted denim jeans, and a cream canvas shoulder backpack. Her right hand lightly rests on a green metal railing, her body faces forward, and her gaze looks off to the left of camera. Add warm rim light on her hair and shoulders, luminous skin, and soft natural shadows.

Background: A summer city walkway with green railings, leafy trees creating circular bokeh, and a glass geometric building facade behind her. Include a small cluster of pink flowers near the lower right edge. The background should be blurred but recognizable, with dappled sunlight and a fresh afternoon mood.

Typography and layout: Design it like a Japanese lifestyle magazine cover with exactly 9 visible text/graphic groups: 1) a very large white handwritten Japanese masthead across the top reading ひだまり; 2) a lime-green handwritten subtitle below it reading 夏日明亮 with a tiny smiley sun doodle; 3) a slim vertical Chinese tagline on the far left reading “关于夏天的光与风，以及心动的瞬间。” with tiny Japanese supporting text beside it; 4) a large white Chinese name near the lower left reading 关晓彤; 5) a lime cursive romanization overlapping the name reading “Guan Xiaotong”; 6) a white Chinese/Japanese cover line below the name reading “阳光正好，与夏天相遇” plus a smaller Japanese line underneath; 7) an upper-right issue block reading “2024 Summer”, “vol.08”, and “ひだまり / 夏日明亮”; 8) a right-side vertical column of three small feature blurbs separated by two lime ring icons, including “街角肖像”, “今の気分”, and “轻快生活”; 9) a lime circular badge at the bottom right reading “夏日限定 / SUMMER ISSUE” with a small sun icon.

Visual style: Photorealistic editorial fashion photography mixed with clean magazine-cover graphic design. Use crisp white brush lettering, lime-yellow accent handwriting, elegant serif issue text, and refined spacing. Keep the subject sharp and the background softly blurred. No watermark, no extra logos, no extra people.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张明亮的日系夏日人像杂志封面，主角为 一位留着深色长卷发、妆容自然清透、佩戴精致耳环、神情平静且略带好奇的东亚年轻女性，她站在户外，沐浴在强烈而柔和的阳光下。

画布：横向 16:9 编辑封面，电影级高分辨率摄影，浅景深，空气感日系生活方式美学，阳光绿与蓝的色调。

主体：女性位于画面中心偏右位置，展示腰部以上。她身穿 一件白色镂空针织无袖背心，搭配浅蓝色高腰牛仔裤和米色帆布单肩包。她的右手轻搭在绿色金属护栏上，身体朝向前方，目光看向镜头左侧。为她的头发和肩膀添加温暖的轮廓光，展现透亮的肤质和柔和的自然阴影。

背景：夏日的城市步道，配有绿色护栏，绿叶树木形成圆形光斑，身后是几何形状的玻璃建筑外墙。在右下角边缘处加入一小簇粉色花朵。背景应模糊但可辨认，呈现斑驳的阳光和清新的午后氛围。

排版与布局：设计风格参考日系生活方式杂志封面，包含 9 组可见的文字/图形：1) 顶部横跨一个非常大的白色手写日文刊名，内容为 ひだまり；2) 下方是一个青柠绿色的手写副标题，内容为 夏日明亮，并配有一个微小的笑脸太阳涂鸦；3) 最左侧有一行细长的竖排中文标语“关于夏天的光与风，以及心动的瞬间。”，旁边配有微小的日文辅助文字；4) 左下方有一个醒目的白色中文姓名，内容为 关晓彤；5) 姓名上方叠加青柠色草书罗马拼音“Guan Xiaotong”；6) 姓名下方有一行白色中日文封面标题“阳光正好，与夏天相遇”，下方配有一行较小的日文；7) 右上角为期号板块，包含“2024 Summer”、“vol.08”以及“ひだまり / 夏日明亮”；8) 右侧竖排三组小型专题简介，由两个青柠色圆环图标分隔，内容包括“街角肖像”、“今の気分”和“轻快生活”；9) 右下角有一个青柠色圆形徽章，写着“夏日限定 / SUMMER ISSUE”并配有一个小太阳图标。

视觉风格：写实主义时尚摄影与简洁杂志封面平面设计的结合。使用清晰的白色笔刷字体、青柠黄色的手写点缀、优雅的衬线期号文字以及精致的留白。保持主体清晰，背景柔焦。无水印，无多余 Logo，无其他人物。
